symptoms.name: Headache

followUpQuestions.q: How long have you had the headache?
How would you describe the pain?

conditions.name: Tension Headache
conditions.description: Most common type of headache. Often feels like a band of pressure around the head.
conditions.action: Rest, hydration, over-the-counter pain relievers

conditions.name: Migraine
conditions.description: Intense, throbbing headache often on one side, may include aura, nausea, light sensitivity.
conditions.action: Rest in dark room, prescribed migraine medication

conditions.name: Cluster Headache
conditions.description: Extremely painful headaches occurring in clusters, usually around one eye.
conditions.action: Seek medical evaluation for proper diagnosis and treatment

conditions.name: Sinusitis
conditions.description: Headache caused by sinus inflammation, often with facial pressure and congestion.
conditions.action: Decongestants, nasal irrigation, see doctor if persistent

conditions.name: Dehydration
conditions.description: Headache from insufficient fluid intake.
conditions.action: Increase water intake, rest

emergencyTriggers: Headache with fever and stiff neck
Headache with confusion or vision loss

symptoms.name: Chest Pain

followUpQuestions.q: What type of pain are you feeling?

conditions.name: Musculoskeletal Pain
conditions.description: Chest wall pain from muscle strain or costochondritis.
conditions.action: Rest, anti-inflammatory medication, warm compress

conditions.name: GERD / Acid Reflux
conditions.description: Burning chest pain from stomach acid flowing back into esophagus.
conditions.action: Antacids, dietary changes, avoid lying down after eating

conditions.name: Anxiety / Panic Attack
conditions.description: Chest tightness and pain during anxiety or panic episodes.
conditions.action: Breathing exercises, stress management, consider counseling

conditions.name: Angina
conditions.description: Chest pain from reduced blood flow to the heart.
conditions.action: Seek immediate medical attention

conditions.name: Pericarditis
conditions.description: Inflammation of the sac around the heart.
conditions.action: See a cardiologist for evaluation

emergencyTriggers: Crushing chest pressure with arm/jaw pain
Chest pain with loss of consciousness

symptoms.name: Fever

followUpQuestions.q: How long have you had fever?

conditions.name: Common Cold / Flu
conditions.description: Viral infection causing fever, body aches, and respiratory symptoms.
conditions.action: Rest, fluids, over-the-counter fever reducers

conditions.name: COVID-19
conditions.description: Respiratory illness that can cause fever, cough, and fatigue.
conditions.action: Get tested, isolate, monitor symptoms

conditions.name: Bacterial Infection
conditions.description: Fever from bacterial source requiring potential antibiotic treatment.
conditions.action: See a doctor for proper diagnosis and antibiotics if needed

conditions.name: Urinary Tract Infection
conditions.description: Infection in the urinary system causing fever and discomfort.
conditions.action: See a doctor for urine test and antibiotics

conditions.name: Heat Exhaustion
conditions.description: Elevated body temperature from prolonged heat exposure.
conditions.action: Cool down, hydrate, rest in shade

emergencyTriggers: Fever with severe headache and stiff neck
Fever with rash that doesn't fade under pressure

symptoms.name: Abdominal Pain

followUpQuestions.q: How would you describe the pain?

conditions.name: Indigestion / Gastritis
conditions.description: Stomach discomfort from eating, stress, or mild inflammation.
conditions.action: Antacids, bland diet, avoid spicy/fatty foods

conditions.name: Irritable Bowel Syndrome
conditions.description: Chronic condition causing cramping, bloating, and altered bowel habits.
conditions.action: Dietary management, stress reduction, see a gastroenterologist

conditions.name: Gastroenteritis
conditions.description: Viral or bacterial stomach infection (stomach flu).
conditions.action: Hydration, rest, BRAT diet, see doctor if symptoms persist

conditions.name: Appendicitis
conditions.description: Inflammation of the appendix, typically right lower abdomen.
conditions.action: Seek emergency medical care immediately

conditions.name: Kidney Stones
conditions.description: Intense pain from mineral deposits passing through urinary tract.
conditions.action: See a doctor, pain management, hydration

emergencyTriggers: Abdominal pain with inability to pass gas or stool
Abdominal pain with high fever and vomiting

symptoms.name: Persistent Cough

followUpQuestions.q: How long have you had it?

conditions.name: Upper Respiratory Infection
conditions.description: Common cold or viral infection of the upper airways.
conditions.action: Rest, fluids, over-the-counter cold medications

conditions.name: Bronchitis
conditions.description: Inflammation of the bronchial tubes, often follows a cold.
conditions.action: Rest, humidifier, see doctor if persistent

conditions.name: Allergies / Postnasal Drip
conditions.description: Cough triggered by allergens or mucus dripping down the throat.
conditions.action: Antihistamines, avoid triggers, nasal rinse

conditions.name: Asthma
conditions.description: Chronic airway condition causing cough, wheezing, and breathlessness.
conditions.action: Inhaler, avoid triggers, see a pulmonologist

conditions.name: Pneumonia
conditions.description: Lung infection causing productive cough, fever, and chest pain.
conditions.action: See a doctor immediately for chest X-ray and antibiotics

emergencyTriggers: Cough with high fever and chest pain

followUpQuestions.q: How long have you been fatigued?

conditions.name: Sleep Deficiency
conditions.description: Not getting adequate quality or quantity of sleep.
conditions.action: Improve sleep hygiene, maintain consistent schedule

conditions.name: Iron Deficiency Anemia
conditions.description: Low iron levels reducing oxygen-carrying capacity of blood.
conditions.action: Blood test, iron supplements, iron-rich diet

conditions.name: Hypothyroidism
conditions.description: Underactive thyroid slowing metabolism and causing fatigue.
conditions.action: Thyroid blood test (TSH), thyroid medication if diagnosed

conditions.name: Depression
conditions.description: Mental health condition that can manifest as persistent fatigue.
conditions.action: Talk to a mental health professional, consider counseling

conditions.name: Vitamin D Deficiency
conditions.description: Low vitamin D levels causing fatigue and muscle weakness.
conditions.action: Blood test, vitamin D supplements, sun exposure

symptoms.name: Back Pain

conditions.name: Muscle Strain
conditions.description: Overuse or injury to back muscles or ligaments.
conditions.action: Rest, ice/heat, gentle stretching, OTC pain relievers

conditions.name: Herniated Disc
conditions.description: Disc material pressing on spinal nerves.
conditions.action: Physical therapy, pain management, see orthopedist

conditions.name: Poor Posture
conditions.description: Chronic pain from prolonged poor posture.
conditions.action: Ergonomic improvements, posture exercises, core strengthening

conditions.name: Sciatica
conditions.description: Pain radiating along the sciatic nerve from lower back to leg.
conditions.action: Physical therapy, anti-inflammatories, see a doctor

conditions.name: Spinal Stenosis
conditions.description: Narrowing of the spinal canal pressing on nerves.
conditions.action: See a spine specialist for evaluation

emergencyTriggers: Back pain with loss of bladder/bowel control
Severe pain after a fall or injury
Back pain with numbness in legs

symptoms.name: Joint Pain

conditions.name: Osteoarthritis
conditions.description: Degenerative joint disease from wear and tear of cartilage.
conditions.action: Exercise, weight management, anti-inflammatories, see rheumatologist

conditions.name: Rheumatoid Arthritis
conditions.description: Autoimmune condition causing joint inflammation and pain.
conditions.action: See a rheumatologist for blood tests and treatment

conditions.name: Gout
conditions.description: Sudden intense joint pain from uric acid crystal buildup.
conditions.action: Anti-inflammatory medication, dietary changes, see doctor

conditions.name: Tendinitis
conditions.description: Inflammation of tendons from overuse.
conditions.action: Rest, ice, gentle stretching, avoid repetitive motions

conditions.name: Bursitis
conditions.description: Inflammation of fluid-filled sacs cushioning joints.
conditions.action: Rest, ice, anti-inflammatories

emergencyTriggers: Sudden severe joint swelling and redness
Joint pain after injury with inability to move

conditions.name: BPPV (Benign Positional Vertigo)
conditions.description: Brief vertigo triggered by head position changes.
conditions.action: Epley maneuver, see ENT specialist

conditions.name: Low Blood Pressure
conditions.description: Dizziness when standing due to blood pressure drop.
conditions.action: Rise slowly, stay hydrated, increase salt intake

conditions.name: Inner Ear Infection
conditions.description: Infection causing vertigo, hearing changes, and nausea.
conditions.action: See a doctor for antibiotics and vestibular therapy

conditions.name: Dehydration
conditions.description: Insufficient fluid intake causing lightheadedness.
conditions.action: Increase water intake, electrolytes

conditions.name: Anemia
conditions.description: Low blood count causing dizziness and fatigue.
conditions.action: Blood test, iron supplements, dietary changes

followUpQuestions.q: What does the rash look like?
How long have you had it?

conditions.name: Contact Dermatitis
conditions.description: Rash from skin contact with an irritant or allergen.
conditions.action: Avoid irritant, hydrocortisone cream, antihistamines

conditions.name: Eczema
conditions.description: Chronic condition causing dry, itchy, inflamed skin.
conditions.action: Moisturizers, topical steroids, avoid triggers

conditions.name: Hives (Urticaria)
conditions.description: Raised, itchy welts from allergic reaction.
conditions.action: Antihistamines, identify and avoid allergen

conditions.name: Fungal Infection
conditions.description: Skin infection caused by fungi (ringworm, athlete's foot).
conditions.action: Antifungal cream, keep area dry

conditions.name: Psoriasis
conditions.description: Autoimmune condition causing thick, scaly skin patches.
conditions.action: See a dermatologist for proper treatment plan

symptoms.name: Shortness of Breath

conditions.name: Asthma
conditions.description: Airway inflammation causing breathing difficulty and wheezing.
conditions.action: Use inhaler, avoid triggers, see pulmonologist

conditions.name: Anxiety / Panic
conditions.description: Breathing difficulty from anxiety or panic attacks.
conditions.action: Breathing exercises, relaxation techniques, counseling

conditions.name: Respiratory Infection
conditions.description: Infection affecting the lungs or airways.
conditions.action: See a doctor, may need antibiotics or antivirals

conditions.name: Heart Failure
conditions.description: Heart unable to pump efficiently, fluid buildup in lungs.
conditions.action: Seek medical attention immediately

conditions.name: COPD
conditions.description: Chronic lung disease causing progressive breathing difficulty.
conditions.action: See a pulmonologist, inhaler therapy, avoid smoking

emergencyTriggers: Shortness of breath with chest pain

symptoms.name: Sore Throat

conditions.name: Viral Pharyngitis
conditions.description: Sore throat caused by a viral infection (common cold).
conditions.action: Rest, warm liquids, throat lozenges, salt water gargle

conditions.name: Strep Throat
conditions.description: Bacterial infection causing severe sore throat and fever.
conditions.action: See a doctor for rapid strep test and antibiotics

conditions.name: Tonsillitis
conditions.description: Inflammation of the tonsils, often with swelling and white spots.
conditions.action: See a doctor, may need antibiotics

conditions.name: Allergies
conditions.description: Throat irritation from postnasal drip due to allergies.
conditions.action: Antihistamines, nasal spray, avoid allergens

conditions.name: Acid Reflux (LPR)
conditions.description: Throat irritation from stomach acid reaching the throat.
conditions.action: Dietary changes, elevate head during sleep, antacids

emergencyTriggers: Sore throat with high fever and rash

mild.label: Mild
mild.description: Usually manageable at home with self-care
